COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social and Ethical Issues in Networking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Data Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
